The '''Aygion offworld quarter''' was a district of [[Aygion Mountain]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. It was set aside for non-[[Gran/Legends|Gran]], and was mostly occupied by various embassies.<ref name="Strongholds" />
